data.body:
CLOSING AS WON'T FIX — the plan's premise is disproven and the design it proposes was already tried and deliberately removed (operator decision, 2026-08-09).

THE STATED PREMISE NO LONGER HOLDS. This plan rests on: '_recover() already splits the work per criterion — a fresh agentic evidence run per checklist item — but runs them SEQUENTIALLY (for index, criterion in enumerate(expected), completion_recovery.py:583)'. That loop does not exist on origin/main. The only enumerate(criteria) left in the module (line 138) is a character-bound validation scan, not an evidence-run loop.

THE PROPOSED DIRECTION WAS ALREADY REJECTED ON THE SAME GROUNDS THIS TICKET ARGUES FROM. The module docstring of src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py records the decision: recovery 'no longer fans out one isolated evidence run PER criterion (that design exploded token/wall-clock cost and discarded the primary's verified work)'; it now 'resumes with BATCHED successor runs over only the UNVERIFIED remainder, denominated in a MODEL-REQUEST budget pool'. Sharding recovery into parallel per-criterion runs would re-introduce exactly the fan-out that was measured, found too expensive, and deleted — while this ticket's own justification is cost and wall-clock.

WHAT SURVIVES, AND WHERE IT GOES. The underlying goal is NOT dismissed. The same docstring confirms 'the ordinary completion workflow keeps its historical one-call fast path', so the monolithic PRIMARY call may still be the gate's wall-clock critical path, and the bug 1e88 telemetry cited here (48 turns / ~30k output tokens / ~468s, corr(dur, output_tokens)=0.982) may still describe it accurately. That is a live concern about the PRIMARY call, not about recovery. It should be re-filed against the CURRENT batched architecture rather than carried on a plan whose context, telemetry framing, and mechanism all describe an architecture that no longer exists — re-scoping in place would leave misleading text for the next reader.

The prevention-side half of the motivation (many-AC closures straining one completion-verification run) is carried by 259c, which right-sizes tickets so those closures do not arise.

Re-scoping was considered and not taken. No work will be done under this id.
